meta.title: Annual wholesale price index, exchange rate and gold-denominated WPI, 1800-2026
meta.wpi_units: local-currency index on its published base: US/DE/FR 1913=100, UK 2015=100, JP 1934-36=100
meta.fx_units: local currency per USD (US fixed at 1)
meta.gold_usd_units: USD per troy ounce (official price to 1967, then market average)
